## Reviewer's Guide The PR hardens streamed tool-call accumulation in the LiteLLM, Mistral, and Azure AI Inference wrappers by coercing null function fields, names, and argument fragments to empty values, preventing TypeErrors while preserving subsequent arguments; parameterized regression tests cover both initial and continuation null-argument deltas. #### Sequence diagram for null-safe streamed tool-call accumulation ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Provider participant process_chunk participant ToolState participant Caller Provider->>process_chunk: process_chunk(scope, chunk) alt New tool with null function fields process_chunk->>ToolState: Store name or "" and arguments or "" else Continuation with null arguments process_chunk->>ToolState: Append new_args or "" end process_chunk-->>Caller: Updated tool-call state Note over Caller: Stream iteration continues without TypeError ``` #### Flow diagram for null argument handling in stream chunks ```mermaid flowchart TD A[process_chunk receives tool delta] --> B{Tool has id?} B -->|Yes| C[Read function or empty object] C --> D[Store name or empty string] D --> E[Store arguments or empty string] B -->|No| F[Read continuation function or empty object] F --> G[Append arguments or empty string] E --> H[Return updated tool state] G --> H ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Normalize null tool-call function fields and argument fragments to empty values before initializing or appending streamed calls. |
  • Treat a null function object as an empty mapping.
  • Initialize null names and arguments as empty strings.
  • Ignore null arguments on continuation deltas before concatenation.
| `sdk/python/src/openlit/instrumentation/azure_ai_inference/utils.py`
`sdk/python/src/openlit/instrumentation/litellm/utils.py`
`sdk/python/src/openlit/instrumentation/mistral/utils.py` | | Add regression coverage for null arguments on initial and continuation tool-call deltas across all affected wrappers. |
  • Parameterize tests for Azure AI Inference, LiteLLM, and Mistral payload shapes.
  • Verify initial null arguments can be followed by valid fragments.
  • Verify continuation null arguments are ignored without breaking concatenation.
| `sdk/python/tests/test_stream_tool_call_null_arguments.py` | ---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai/dashboard/review-settings?connection=github&owner=openlit&from_surface=github_bot&intent=review_settings) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).
